channel.title: NeedPro Guides
channel.description: Visas, insurance, SIM cards, money and moving abroad: answers from official sources, each with the date it was checked.

item.title: Thailand visa exemption 2026: 30 days, not 60
item.description: Since 15 September 2026 Thailand's tourist visa exemption gives 30 days, not 60. You need an onward ticket and a TDAC arrival card filed 3 days ahead.

item.title: Schengen calculator: count your 90/180 days
item.description: Enter your trips and a date: days used in the 180-day window, days left, your last allowed day and the next full 90 days. EU rule checked 6 Nov 2026.

item.title: How much cash can I bring to China? RMB and USD limits
item.description: Chinese yuan: RMB 20,000 is a hard cap, the rest is prohibited. Foreign cash: no cap, but over USD 5,000 must be declared in writing at customs.

item.title: UK ETA cost in 2026: £20, and who needs one in transit
item.description: A UK ETA costs £20 on GOV.UK, lasts 2 years or until your passport expires, and is needed for transit if you pass through UK border control.

item.title: Turkey IMEI registration: 120 days, fee and limits
item.description: A foreign phone works in Turkey for 120 days, then must be registered for a fee (54,258 TL in 2026). One phone per 3 years, one line per operator.

item.title: Do you have to pay tourist tax? Lisbon, Paris rates
item.description: Yes, if the city charges it and you stay in paid lodging. Lisbon: €4 a night for guests over 13. Paris 2026: €2.60 to €15.93 per adult per night.

item.title: EU261 compensation table: €250, €400, €600 and when
item.description: EU261 pays €250, €400 or €600 by distance for a delay of 3+ hours, a late cancellation or denied boarding. The table, the halving rule and where to complain.

item.title: Does my phone support eSIM? 4 checks before you travel
item.description: iPhone XS, XR and later support eSIM; on Android check the settings. A carrier-locked phone can't use a travel eSIM. Also: when to install it and calls.

item.title: How much cash can I bring to Europe? The €10,000 rule
item.description: No EU limit on cash, but €10,000 or more must be declared at the EU border. What counts as cash, and the rules in France, Ireland, Spain and Portugal.

item.title: Passport validity requirements by country: 7 rules
item.description: Schengen wants 3 months after you leave and an issue date under 10 years; UAE and India want 6 months; Turkey wants your stay plus 60 days. Sources inside.

item.title: Bali tourist tax 2026: Rp 150,000, how and when to pay
item.description: Bali charges foreign tourists Rp 150,000 per person, once per trip, paid cashless online via Love Bali or at airport counters. KITAS holders are exempt.

item.title: Digital nomad visa: what it is and four country rules
item.description: A digital nomad visa lets you live in a country while working for a foreign employer. Spain, Thailand, the UAE and Indonesia set income or savings bars.

item.title: Bali visa on arrival 2026: cost, 30 days, documents
item.description: Indonesia's visa on arrival (B1) costs Rp 500,000, allows up to 30 days and can be extended once by 30 days. You need a 6-month passport and an onward ticket.
